e.summary: 英国长寿与老龄化智库：以「长寿经济」为框架发布政策简报与报告，实测含中国专题《Making China longevity ready》与欧洲机遇报告
e.summary_en: A UK longevity and ageing think tank: it publishes policy briefings and reports framed around the "longevity economy", with a measured China report, "Making China longevity ready", and a European opportunity report
e.summary_hk: 英國長壽與老齡化智庫：以「長壽經濟」為框架發布政策簡報與報告，實測含中國專題《Making China longevity ready》與歐洲機遇報告
e.body:
**ILC-UK（International Longevity Centre UK，国际长寿中心英国）** 是**英国的长寿与老龄化政策智库**。本条目属本轮**长寿主题的政策侧补位**——池内长寿/老龄化侧此前已有**研究机构**（[[cepar]]，侧重老龄化研究 + 数据档案）与**养老金政策建模**（[[pensions-policy-institute]]），而**「以长寿经济为框架、面向政策与公众的智库产出」这一形态缺位**；实测池内 **ILC 相关条目为 0**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 **70.8KB**；⭐ **实测到的报告页面**包括：**《Making China longevity ready》（中国长寿准备度，`/making-china-longevity-ready/`，98.7KB）**、**《ILC briefing: longevity economy》（长寿经济简报，`/ilc-briefing-longevity-economy/`，136.9KB）**、**《Economies for long lives – quantifying the longevity…》（为长寿人生构建经济，`/economies-for-long-lives/`，110.5KB）**，以及首页实测可见的 **《An age of economic opportunity: maximising the European…》（欧洲长寿经济机遇）**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「长寿经济」这一分析框架**——池内长寿侧此前主要沿**死亡率/长寿风险的建模口径**（[[human-mortality-db]]、[[cmi-mortality-projections]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]]）与**养老金制度/产品口径**（[[pbgc]]、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]]、[[ap7]]、[[club-vita]]），而 **ILC-UK 采用的是「长寿经济（longevity economy）」框架——把老龄化看成消费、就业与增长的经济机会，而非单纯的负债**；对做**老龄化与保险/养老金市场关系**方向的学生，**这是与精算口径互补的第二种视角**（同一现象，一个算成本、一个算机会）。**② 中国专题报告对本站读者有直接相关性**——实测报告页 **《Making China longevity ready》** 说明该机构把中国作为研究样本，**对香港/内地的学生而言，这提供了一个「外部机构如何看中国老龄化」的可引用文本**（可与 [[un-population-data]]、[[hk-censtatd-insurance]]、[[mpf-fund-platform]]、[[retirement-planning]] 并读）。**③ 与 [[cepar]] 形成「研究机构 vs 政策智库」的对照**——**同一老龄化议题，一个以数据档案与研究计划为主线，一个以政策简报与公众沟通为主线**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① 这是智库/倡导型机构而非同行评审来源**——其报告**结论带有政策主张**，引用时应与学术期刊区别对待（本词条在此明确提示）；**②** 本次核实到**首页与四个报告页面的存在、标题与页面体量**，**但未打开任何报告正文**，因此**不能转述其数据来源、方法与结论**；**③ 机构的资助结构、治理与独立性本次未核实**——这一点对评估智库研究尤为关键，**故不作任何独立性评价**；**④** 本词条**不主张**该站提供数据下载或精算工具。**核实说明**：首页（70.8KB）、`/making-china-longevity-ready/`（98.7KB）、`/ilc-briefing-longevity-economy/`（136.9KB）、`/economies-for-long-lives/`（110.5KB）均 HTTP 200 实测并读取标题；**未打开报告正文、未核实资助结构**。

e.body_en:
**ILC-UK (International Longevity Centre UK)** is **a UK longevity and ageing policy think tank**. This entry fills the **policy side of the longevity theme** — the corpus’s longevity and ageing side already had **research institutions** ([[cepar]], focused on ageing research and a data archive) and **pension policy modelling** ([[pensions-policy-institute]]), while **the "think-tank output framed around the longevity economy and aimed at policy and the public" form was missing**; **ILC-related entries measured zero**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage is **70.8KB**; ⭐ **measured report pages** include **"Making China longevity ready" (`/making-china-longevity-ready/`, 98.7KB)**, **"ILC briefing: longevity economy" (`/ilc-briefing-longevity-economy/`, 136.9KB)** and **"Economies for long lives – quantifying the longevity…" (`/economies-for-long-lives/`, 110.5KB)**, plus **"An age of economic opportunity: maximising the European…"** visible on the homepage.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "longevity economy" analytical frame** — the corpus’s longevity side previously ran along the **mortality and longevity-risk modelling** axis ([[human-mortality-db]], [[cmi-mortality-projections]], [[longevity-mortality-investor]]) and the **pension institution and product** axis ([[pbgc]], [[apra-superannuation-statistics]], [[ap7]], [[club-vita]]), whereas **ILC-UK uses the "longevity economy" frame — treating ageing as an economic opportunity in consumption, employment and growth rather than purely a liability**; for students working on **the relationship between ageing and insurance or pension markets**, this is **a second lens complementary to the actuarial one** (the same phenomenon, one counting costs and the other opportunities). **② The China report is directly relevant to this wiki’s readers** — the measured page **"Making China longevity ready"** shows the institute treating China as a research subject, giving **a citable outside view of Chinese ageing** for Hong Kong and mainland students (readable with [[un-population-data]], [[hk-censtatd-insurance]], [[mpf-fund-platform]] and [[retirement-planning]]). **③ It contrasts with [[cepar]] as "research institution versus policy think tank"** — **the same ageing agenda, one led by data archives and research programmes, the other by policy briefings and public communication**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① this is a think tank and advocacy-oriented institution, not a peer-reviewed source** — its reports **carry policy positions** and should be cited differently from academic journals (flagged explicitly here); **②** this check verified **the existence, titles and page sizes of the homepage and four report pages**, **but opened no report body**, so **its data sources, methods and conclusions cannot be restated**; **③ the institution’s funding structure, governance and independence were not verified** — a point that matters especially for assessing think-tank research, **so no independence judgement is offered**; **④** this entry **does not claim the site offers data downloads or actuarial tools**. **Verification note**: the homepage (70.8KB), `/making-china-longevity-ready/` (98.7KB), `/ilc-briefing-longevity-economy/` (136.9KB) and `/economies-for-long-lives/` (110.5KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with titles read; **no report body was opened and no funding structure was verified**.

e.body_hk:
**ILC-UK（International Longevity Centre UK，國際長壽中心英國）** 是**英國的長壽與老齡化政策智庫**。本條目屬本輪**長壽主題的政策側補位**——池內已有**研究機構**（[[cepar]]）與**養老金政策建模**（[[pensions-policy-institute]]），而**「以長壽經濟為框架、面向政策與公眾的智庫產出」這一形態缺位**；實測池內 **ILC 相關條目為 0**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 **70.8KB**；⭐ **實測到的報告頁**包括 **《Making China longevity ready》（中國長壽準備度，98.7KB）**、**《ILC briefing: longevity economy》（長壽經濟簡報，136.9KB）**、**《Economies for long lives》（為長壽人生構建經濟，110.5KB）**，以及首頁可見的**歐洲長壽經濟機遇報告**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「長壽經濟」這一分析框架**——池內長壽側此前主要沿**死亡率/長壽風險建模口徑**與**養老金制度/產品口徑**，而 **ILC-UK 採用「長壽經濟」框架——把老齡化看成消費、就業與增長的經濟機會，而非單純負債**；**同一現象，一個算成本、一個算機會**；**② 中國專題報告對本站讀者有直接相關性**——**《Making China longevity ready》**提供**「外部機構如何看中國老齡化」**的可引用文本；**③ 與 [[cepar]] 形成「研究機構 vs 政策智庫」對照**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① 這是智庫／倡導型機構而非同行評審來源**——其報告**結論帶有政策主張**，引用時應與學術期刊區別對待；**②** 本次核實到**首頁與四個報告頁的存在、標題與體量**，**但未打開任何報告正文**；**③ 資助結構、治理與獨立性未核實**——**故不作任何獨立性評價**；**④** 本詞條**不主張**該站提供數據下載或精算工具**。**核實說明**：四頁 HTTP 200 實測；**未打開報告正文、未核實資助結構**。
